g.text: Installed AI compute has grown 334-fold in 4 years

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: installed AI compute by owner, in H100-equivalents, across the 16 complete quarters Epoch publishes. 20.9M

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: H100e across 10 owners by 2025Q4, up from 63k at 2022Q1. H100e is Epoch's normalising unit — an H100-equivalent of compute

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: — so a TPU and a Blackwell can be added together. It flattens real differences in how those chips serve inference.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Owners (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI chip owners documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: "Other", "China" and "China (smuggled)" are aggregates rather than organisations, and are labelled so no reading treats them as one

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: company. Almost none of this is disclosed by the owners: Epoch estimates it from filings, supply-chain reporting and satellite work,

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: and publishes a 5th-95th percentile beside every median. OWNERS-D02 charts that interval, which is wide and very uneven. The final

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: quarter in the download (2026Q1) is excluded: every row in it is flagged incomplete at source and the cumulative total falls, which

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is missing coverage rather than chips being switched off.
